attributes.title: 30th Annual NPWH Women's Healthcare Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Nurse Practitioners in Women's Health
attributes.summary:
NPWH has announced its 30th Annual Women's Healthcare Conference for October 6 to 8, 2027, at the St. Paul RiverCentre in St. Paul, Minnesota. The meeting is aimed at women's health nurse practitioners, other advanced practice nurses, students and leaders in women's and gender-related care.

So far only a save-the-date has been published. The program, CE contact hours and registration fees are not yet available; we will update this page when they appear.
